svg.aria-label: Map of St Columba's places and churches, numbered: 1 Iona, with an inset showing Iona Abbey, St Martin's and St John's high crosses, St Oran's chapel and the Reilig Odhráin burial ground, the hill of Dùn Ì, the Bay at the Back of the Ocean, Port na Curaich or St Columba's Bay where he landed, and the nunnery; 2 Gartan, his birthplace; 3 Derry; 4 Durrow, home of the Book of Durrow; 5 Kells, home of the Book of Kells, with an inset showing St Columb's House, the round tower and South Cross, and the Market Cross; 6 Glencolumbkille; 7 Drumcliff, near the battlefield of Cúl Dreimhne; 8 Craig Phadrig, the fort of King Bridei by Inverness and the River Ness; 9 Keil in Kintyre, his first landing by tradition; 10 Hinba; 11 Lindisfarne; 12 Clonard and 13 Movilla, where he studied; 14 Dunadd, the fortress of Dál Riata.

g.text: St Martin’s and St John’s crosses
Bay at the Back of the Ocean
Iona: his abbey and his grave
Drumcliff: the battle and a church
Dunadd: the kings of Dál Riata
